title: Normal: refund in progress, customer asks when it arrives

ticket.message: Hi, I returned the running shoes from order ORD-1003. When will I get my money back?

gold.why: Inspection passed on 6 Nov, refund initiated on 9 Nov (within 2 business days) by UPI; only 1 business day of the 1-3 day UPI window has passed (POL-REF-02). Nothing is wrong yet.

title: Scenario A: marked delivered, customer says not received

ticket.message: My order ORD-1001 shows delivered on 7th November but I never received it. Nobody at home got any package. Please help.

gold.why: 63 hours since the Delivered scan, no photo or signature, GPS point 1,850 m from the address (POL-DNR-02). Order is Rs 3,499 and the customer has no prior claims, so both an investigation and a goodwill reshipment are policy-compliant; which is better depends on how often this carrier's investigations succeed.

title: Scenario A (variant): repeat claimant, high-value signed delivery

ticket.message: Order ORD-1002 not received! I want my refund immediately.

gold.why: Rs 14,999 order, delivery signed by 'K. Shah' with photo and GPS 25 m, and the customer has 3 not-received claims in 12 months: POL-DNR-03 requires a Risk & Fraud review, not a refund or a routine investigation.

title: Edge: not received, but reported only 20 hours after the Delivered scan

ticket.message: The app says my wireless mouse (ORD-1007) was delivered yesterday but I did not receive it.

gold.why: Only 20 hours since the Delivered scan. POL-DNR-01: ask the customer to check with neighbours and security, re-check after 48 hours; an investigation or replacement is premature.

title: Scenario B: return passed inspection, refund status has not changed

ticket.message: My air fryer return for ORD-1004 was picked up two weeks back and the app says inspection passed, but there is still no refund. What is going on?

gold.why: Inspection passed on 30 Oct; 7 business days later the refund is still 'not_initiated', far past the 2-business-day initiation SLA (POL-REF-01). Escalate to Finance Ops as P1.

title: Scenario C: conflicting and incomplete information

ticket.message: I ordered a blue kurta, order no ORD-1006, it never arrived and the refund also hasn't come. Please refund Rs 2,199 now.

gold.why: ORD-1006 belongs to a different customer (C106), is for a ceramic dinner set worth Rs 4,250 (not a Rs 2,199 kurta), has no tracking events, and has no return or refund on file. POL-VER-01: do not disclose or act; ask the customer to confirm the order number, registered email and invoice.
